# Ashlyticss

> Ashlyticss is a data analytics agency based in Ahmedabad, India. It turns scattered spreadsheets into live Power BI dashboards — connecting data sources, cleaning the data, building the data model and handing over a working dashboard — for businesses in India and abroad.

## About

Founded by Kuldeep Thakkar (Founder & Lead Analyst). Clients work directly with the person who builds their dashboards. Ashlyticss also built and operates ShapedOps (https://www.shapedops.com), an order-to-cash system for manufacturers, foundries and traders: every order on one line from enquiry to payment, with documents and WhatsApp updates at each stage.

## How a project runs

1. Discovery call (30 minutes, no preparation needed)
2. Scope and proposal within 24 hours: fixed scope, fixed price and timeline, agreed in writing
3. First working version within 48–72 hours of receiving the data; most builds finalised within a week
4. Handoff with a recorded walkthrough, written documentation and 30 days of WhatsApp support

An NDA is signed before any data is shared.

## Services

- Power BI dashboards
- Sales analytics
- Financial reporting (P&L, cash flow, budget vs actual)
- Marketing analytics (ROAS, CAC, attribution)
- Customer analytics (RFM, churn, lifetime value, cohorts)
- Data engineering / ETL pipelines and data warehouses

## Tools

Power BI, DAX, Power Query, Tableau, Looker Studio, Excel, SQL, Python, dbt, Airflow, Fivetran, BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Azure, AWS, Google Cloud.

## Where

Based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Works remotely over email, WhatsApp and Zoom with businesses in India, the Middle East, the UK, the US and beyond.
